## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Tech, Healthcare, Materials). Confirmation: very narrow leadership concentrated in big Tech (Top 5: 4/5 Tech) and overall sector returns are mixed (only 3 sectors positive), so market signals are conflicted; Style: Growth-leaning but narrow.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing selective strength: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY. Materials modestly positive (sector 1W +0.71%) with no dominant SP100 breakout today.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Tech) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND, FDX (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication, Tech pockets and Industrials/Refiners.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65%), INTC (1W: +13.26%), META (1W: +12.99%), AMD (1W: +12.65%), SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY — watch SHOP and AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY for short-term divergence versus 1M.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows concentrated upside with multiple leaders ABOVE TREND (QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND) alongside clear losers (INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND). Sector action is narrow — upside exists but participation uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft overall with SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND; MA (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY is a short-term bounce. Breadth and price action do not confirm a cyclical rotation into Financials.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is one of the few positive sectors with PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND shows mixed internals; several names are in RECOVERY (LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY). Sector is defensive-leaning but selective.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a neutral posture and monitor position sizing given narrow leadership; favor selective exposure to Tech leaders (QCOM, INTC, META) while reducing exposure to clearly BELOW TREND Financials and utilities. Watch RECOVERY names (SHOP, AMGN, MA) for tactical entry if momentum broadens.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (one of 3 positive sectors; leaders are concentrated). BEARISH: Energy and Utilities (both showing downside pressure and several CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND names). Breadth remains the overriding watchpoint: 3/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 1W strength to hold above recent breakout (NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND) for further upside; AAPL support zone to watch near prior consolidations (AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND). SCHW weakness below near-term support (SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND) would signal broader Financials stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+55): LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming. SHOP (+50): SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY — sentiment and surge suggest short-term accumulation versus 1M weakness. SCHW (+45): SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverges; watch for distribution vs true reversal.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-55): BA (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm price weakness. PSX (-50): PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION — bearish news aligning with short-term pullback despite 1M strength. CMCSA (-65) and IBM (-60) flagged by sentiment but lack SP100 dual-timeframe context here; monitor if price confirms.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, growth-leaning given concentrated Tech leadership but mixed internals. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow leadership and mixed sentiment/price divergences (SCHW sentiment positive but price BELOW TREND; SHOP and AMGN show RECOVERY vs 1M weakness).
